extracted.intended_audience: members of the public and stakeholders who wish to comment on FAA exemption petitions (notice-and-comment participants)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for submitting public comments on a Federal Aviation Administration petition for exemption (14 CFR 11.85 summary). Covers required content, submission methods, deadlines, privacy/posting, and docket access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments deadline and docket identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments on this petition must identify the petition docket number and must be received on or before July 7, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any comments submitted must include the petition docket number (FAA-2023-2317) and be received by the specified closing date. The DATES section sets the final receipt date for comments; late comments may not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted methods for submitting comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Send comments identified by docket number FAA-2023-2317 using any of the following methods: Federal eRulemaking Portal (http://www.regulations.gov), mail, hand delivery/courier, or fax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Regulations.gov: go to the site and follow the online instructions for sending comments electronically. Mail to Docket Operations, M-30; U.S. Department of Transportation, 1200 New Jersey Avenue SE, Room W12-140. Hand deliver to Room W12-140 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday through Friday (except Federal holidays). Fax to (202) 493-2251.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and public posting of comments
rubrics_metrics.description: In accordance with 5 U.S.C. 553(c), DOT posts comments, without edit, including any personal information the commenter provides, to http://www.regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commenters should be aware that personal information included in submissions may be made publicly available. Review the DOT system of records notice (DOT/ALL-14 FDMS) and DOT privacy information at http://www.dot.gov/privacy for details. Do not include information you do not want publicly posted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency review, redaction, and withholding of submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies review all submissions and may choose to redact, or withhold, certain submissions (or portions thereof). Submitted comments may not be available to be read until the agency has approved them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no guarantee that a posted comment will appear immediately or in full on Regulations.gov; agencies may screen and redact material per their procedures. Expect possible delays and redactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket access and how to read background documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Background documents or comments received may be read at http://www.regulations.gov at any time; or in person at Docket Operations in Room W12-140 of the West Building Ground Floor at 1200 New Jersey Avenue SE between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the online instructions for accessing the docket on Regulations.gov. Physical inspection is available at the specified address during business hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document headings and required Federal Register sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal Register documents typically include the agency name, affected CFR parts, agency docket number/internal file number, RIN, and standard headings such as AGENCY, ACTION, SUMMARY, DATES, ADDRESSES, FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Document Drafting Handbook for more details; the repetition of headings in the online display is a navigational tool and has no substantive legal effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nature and legal effect of the petition summary publication
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice contains a summary of a petition seeking relief from specified requirements of Federal Aviation Regulations. Neither publication of this notice nor the inclusion nor omission of information in the summary is intended to affect the legal status of the petition or its final disposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The summary is published to improve public awareness and participation in the FAA's exemption process, but the summary itself does not determine legal outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation that notice is published pursuant to 14 CFR 11.85
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice is published pursuant to 14 CFR 11.85.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publication under 14 CFR 11.85 reflects the statutory/regulatory procedure for FAA petition summaries; consult that regulation for procedural requirements governing petitions for exemption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required elements in the petition summary (document content elements)
rubrics_metrics.description: The summary includes: Docket No.; Petitioner name; Section(s) of 14 CFR affected; Description of Relief Sought (e.g., sought relief to allow specified pilot to act as PIC of a fully autonomous unmanned aircraft under Special Airworthiness Certificate Experimental Category).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition summary should concisely identify who is petitioning, the specific regulatory provisions at issue, and a clear description of the relief requested so the public can understand and comment meaningfully.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verification against official Federal Register edition
rubrics_metrics.description: The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov is unofficial and those relying on it for legal research should verify their results against an official edition of the Federal Register (PDF on govinfo.gov). Only official editions provide legal notice and judicial notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When accuracy or legal effect matters, consult the official PDF on govinfo.gov or the print Federal Register; the site notes that the XML-based display will remain unofficial until ACFR grants it official status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point of contact for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a point of contact for questions (e.g., Jake Troutman, (202) 267-2928, Office of Rulemaking, Federal Aviation Administration).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full contact details (name, phone, office, address) in the FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT section so interested parties can obtain clarifications.
